discovery_candidates.name: websoft9
discovery_candidates.description: Applications self-hosting and DevOps platform for running open source, web-based linux Panel of lite PaaS.

install_startup.recipe: native (partial: console + apphub-api + apphub-media only; the real docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exists but this session's container cannot pull any Docker image, and this app's own architecture bundles Gitea/Portainer/Nginx-Proxy-Manager plus docker.sock access into one image for its App Store feature, which is out of scope for a native re-verification of this depth)
install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The automated pipeline's 'no Dockerfile or compose file' finding was stale -- the repo has a real docker/Dockerfile and docker/docker-compose.dev.yml. Docker wasn't usable here regardless (image pulls blocked, same as elsewhere on this shelf). This app's full single-container image bundles four separate services (its own console+apphub, plus binaries extracted from gitea/gitea, portainer/portainer-ce, and jc21/nginx-proxy-manager images) glued together by supervisord, with its core App Store deploy feature requiring /var/run/docker.sock access to manage OTHER containers -- that feature is a real, disclosed hard gap in this sandbox (no Docker at all), not something a native build works around. What *was* verified natively: the console (Node/Vite/React) built and run via its own dev server, and the apphub Python backend (FastAPI, requirements.txt installed clean in a venv) run as its two real processes (src.main:app on 8080, src.media:app on 8081/9092) -- the exact same processes supervisord runs in the real image, minus gitea/portainer/npm. One missing runtime directory (/websoft9/media, normally created by the Docker image's own build) had to be created by hand for apphub-media to start; no code changes were needed otherwise beyond pointing the console's vite dev proxy at the two apphub ports directly instead of through the full nginx gateway (also skipped).
install_startup.startup_command: apphub: WEBSOFT9_DATA_ROOT=/opt/websoft9/data python3 -m uvicorn src.main:app --port 8080 (and src.media:app --port 9092); console: WEBSOFT9_DEV_APPHUB_API=http://127.0.0.1:8080 WEBSOFT9_DEV_APPHUB_MEDIA=http://127.0.0.1:9092 npx vite --port 5173
